title: Critique Economic Drain
definition: The systematic transfer of India's wealth and economic resources to Britain without any adequate economic, commercial, or material return, which formed the core of British colonial exploitation.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding Indian nationalism, economic nationalism of early nationalists (Moderates), Modern History (GS-1), and colonial economic history (GS-3 Economy/Growth).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Critique Economic Drain.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of British Land Revenue Systems
